Aurora Cloud Tart

By Rowan ValePhotography by Sky Lens
Sky Lens

A bright invented tart.

Made for testing.

Tips

Editorial advice, not the description.

Recipe information

  • Total Time

    1 hour 15 minutes

  • Yield

    4 servings

Ingredients

Filling

1½

cups cloud flour (190 g)

2

Tbsp. sky oil

To finish

Salt to taste

Preparation

  1. Filling

    Step 1

    Mix cloud flour with oil.

    Step 2

    Chill the filling.

    Do Ahead: Make the filling one day ahead.

  2. Assembly

    Step 3

    Bake until golden.

    VARIATIONS

    For a blue tart, add blue beans.

    Editor's note: Invented for this fixture.

Calories: 200
